claims.quote: Crossocheilus nigriloba is a cyprinid endemic to Borneo, known from the Kapuas, Belayan and Mahakam rivers in Indonesian Kalimantan.
Endemic to the island of Borneo where it appears to be restricted to rivers draining Kalimantan, the Indonesian part of the island.
